name_reason: Structurally compliant (fd2_<render>_<descriptor>), no address residue, no domain-ID issue. The function is precisely the church-revive candidate grid renderer (NOT shared with class promotion, which uses the separate fd2_render_promote_candidates_grid @ 0x31019). 'promote_members' is mildly imprecise vs 'revive', but it is the consistent naming family used across the whole revive-flow chain (sole caller fd2_promote_members_select_loop @ 0x30C22, cost table per_job_revive_or_promote_cost_table). Renaming only the renderer would break that chain's consistency; renaming the family is out of scope for a single symbol. The descriptor still distinguishes it from fd2_render_promote_candidates_grid. Keep.
purpose: Render the church-revive candidate selection grid: up to 3 visible characters in one column, each row showing the character portrait (24x24, blink-animated), char-name/archetype/job FDTXT labels, a gold coin icon, and the per-job revive price (level x per-job cost, 5-digit orange decimal); the row matching highlight_idx gets the highlighted border glyph.
logic_summary: blink_frame = subframe_counter, remapped 3->1 (cycle 0,1,2,1). draw_count = min(candidate_count, 3). For iter in 0..draw_count-1: char_idx = candidate_idx_list[scroll_offset+iter]; read rt_chars[char_idx].job_id and .level (status_flags_block[0]); row_off = iter*0x1A. Blit blink-variant portrait at surface_offset+0xE + (row_off+0x75)*0x140 (src = cache + cache[char_idx*0x30 + blink_frame*4]). border_glyph = 0xC9 if (scroll_offset+iter == highlight_idx) else 0xCD. At text_col = surface_offset + (row_off+0x79)*0x140, draw three FDTXT labels: char name (page char_id+1, +0x28), archetype (page archetype_flag+0x8C, +0x82), job (page job_id+0x96, +0xAF). At price_y = surface_offset + (row_off+0x7D)*0x140: coin icon sprite 0xF from menu atlas at +0xDC; price = (int16)cost_table[job_id-1] * level rendered as 5-digit colour-0x77 number at +0xE4.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_render_promote_members_grid(uint32 candidate_count, uint32 surface_offset, uint32 highlight_idx, uint8 *candidate_idx_list)

params.name: candidate_count
params.semantics: Number of revive candidates; clamped to min(., 3) for the visible draw count (the viewport shows at most 3 rows).
params.reason: Accurately names the count; no address residue.

params.name: surface_offset
params.semantics: Base linear byte offset of the compose surface (workspace_c buffer on first render, or 0xA0000 VRAM on re-renders); all row blits/labels/price are positioned relative to it.
params.reason: Accurately names the destination surface base; no address residue.

params.name: highlight_idx
params.semantics: Cursor index whose row receives the highlighted border glyph (0xC9); compared against scroll_offset+iter so it is the absolute candidate index of the selected row.
params.reason: Accurately names the highlighted-row index; no address residue.

params.name: candidate_idx_list
params.semantics: Pointer to an array of runtime_char indices (the dead/revivable characters); char_idx = candidate_idx_list[scroll_offset + iter] selects which runtime_char to render per row.
params.reason: Accurately names the candidate-index array; no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; pure side-effect renderer drawing into the compose surface.

reads_globals: data_fd2_all_game_text_ptr (@0x53A7D, FDTXT base for name/archetype/job labels)
data_fd2_ui_per_job_revive_or_promote_cost_table (@0x5266B, int16 per-job cost multiplier indexed job_id-1)
comment_original_issue: src comment claimed the renderer is 'Shared by both the promote-member and class-promotion menu loops (both display the same fields)'. This is stale/incorrect: the function is called ONLY from the church-revive picker (fd2_promote_members_select_loop, promote.c lines 106/126/138); class promotion uses the separate fd2_render_promote_candidates_grid @ 0x31019 (post-promotion target job, not a price). Neighbouring comments (the caller's and fd2_run_revive_menu_main's) were already corrected to the revive-only framing.
notes: Single caller chain confirmed via grep + Ghidra callers/xrefs: only fd2_promote_members_select_loop @ 0x30C22 (xrefs from 0x30ce8 and 0x30d5e). runtime_char struct fields (job_id@+0x20, char_id@+0x08, archetype_flag@+0x1F, status_flags_block[0]@+0x21=level) verified in src/include/types.h and match the src body usage. Both src comment and Ghidra plate edited to replace the stale 'shared by both' claim with the church-revive-only framing; plate also corrected to show border_glyph compares scroll_offset+iter (not char_idx) and cost-table index is job_id-1, matching the decompile. No logic touched.
